newsitem.title: THAILAND: Finance ministers approves Thai Trust Fund launch.
newsitem.headline: Finance ministers approves Thai Trust Fund launch.

text.p: Finance Minister Bodi Chunnananda said on Wednesday he would approve a regulation allowing the private sector to set up Thai Trust Funds, a vehicle designed to help foreign investors circumvent Thai corporate ownership limits.

Bodi told reporters he expects foreign investors would be keen to buy units in the Thai incorporated mutual funds, through which they could buy shares above current 25-49 percent foreign ownership limits set for listed Thai companies.

Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) oficials said the trust funds, to be managed by Thai fund managers, would help phase out a common practice of foreign investors in side- stepping Thai ownership restrictions by buying shares through Thai nominees.
Bodi said SEC is expected to accept applications for launching Thai Trust Funds soon after the regulation is gazetted this week.
